title: Swept spec-4-1 line retains both 'Strain measure' heading and 'the ladder is dropping'
evidence: +- **Strain measure (the pinned contract):** node utilization = Σ `packet_bandwidth` of packets RESIDENT at the node that **FAILED a forward attempt** (`Packet.waiting_ticks >= 1` — incremented in flow.odin's forward pass when no route exists, cleared on every successful forward) × 100 ÷ `node_types[node_type].throughput_units` (integer percent). A packet that forwards next tick — fresh spawn OR fresh transit arrival — has `waiting_ticks` 0 and NEVER congests (the no-flicker contract; the transit case was the reason the spawn-tick exclusion alone was insufficient — see the change log). Pipe congestion = the FULLEST lane queue's depth on the bundle vs its E9 bound (`lane_queue_packets × packet_bandwidth`): a lone packet is 1/6 of a bound (17 %, healthy); a lane at its bound (6 packets) is 100 % — the ladder is dropping. "Congestion climbing toward saturation" (GDD M5), not busy-ness.
detail: This line was fully swept (strain→congest, pressure→congestion) yet keeps the coinage heading 'Strain measure (the pinned contract):' and 'the ladder is dropping'; the renamed 'drop precedence' never appears in it.
recommended_fix: Rename the heading to 'Congestion measure (the pinned contract)' and 'the ladder is dropping' to 'the drop precedence is shedding'.

title: spec-3-3 E22 matrix row keeps 'the ladder sheds the lowest-priority non-empty lane's newest' while the E9 row above it and the AC were renamed
location: _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-3-3-contention.md, I/O & Edge-Case Matrix (E9/E22 rows) + Acceptance Criteria
evidence:
+| E9 ladder | lane full; lower-class queue non-empty | shed that lane's NEWEST packet (Queue_Overflow event), admit the arrival | n/a |
 | E22 pool | pool at `pool_max_packets`; spawn arrives | the ladder sheds the lowest-priority non-empty lane's newest; the arrival is admitted ONLY when that target is STRICTLY lower priority than its own lane, else the arrival drops (the inversion guard — an Express resident never pays for a Standard arrival) | n/a |
+- Given the pool at `pool_max_packets`, when a spawn arrives, then E22 drops the lowest-class queue first; every drop emits `Packet_Dropped{class, reason}` and the run replays byte-identically (E10).
detail: Same file, same sweep: the AC ('E22 drops the lowest-class queue first') and the E9 row ('lower-class queue') were renamed, but the E22 row one line below the E9 row keeps both ruled coinages — 'the ladder' and 'lane'.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the E22 row: 'the drop precedence sheds the lowest-priority non-empty class queue's newest'; relabel row 'E9 ladder' → 'E9 precedence'.

title: Everyday-English 'pressure' over-renamed to 'congestion' in canon docs ('modernization congestion', 'time congestion', 'fair congestion from your topology')
location: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/gdds/gdd-packet-plumber-2026-08-05/gdd.md (M1, P3, triage mode, Controls, Audio, Run Structure, Accessibility, stress-test) | epics.md E5 | sprint-plan-v2.md Slice 6 | stories-v2.md Slice 6 exit
evidence:
+**Delivers** modernization congestion. MVP ships **one** transition (Email → Streaming). *Playable value: the player experiences the internet evolving and must modernize.*
+- **During crises (triage mode):** the player prioritizes and reroutes under time congestion — the crisis layer (P3). Failure state here is *fast SLA collapse*.
+**→ Slice 6 exit:** modernization congestion is felt — the internet evolves, you must keep up.
+- **The V2 AI stress-test** (full-game): generates fresh, fair congestion from your topology — high replayability, scoped carefully (forge weak point #4).
detail: The ruling renames the pipe-warning coinage ('pressure → congestion'); these are everyday-English uses ('modernization pressure', 'time pressure', 'fair pressure') that the sweep blindly replaced, producing semantically broken canon prose ('modernization congestion is felt').
recommended_fix: Restore the ordinary word in non-mechanic prose: 'modernization pressure', 'time pressure', 'fair pressure'; keep 'congestion' only for the warning mechanic.
